source.text_it: Il motore Diesel può essere alimentato anche con bioetanolo

records.localized_text: A diesel engine can also run on bioethanol.

source.text_it: Le candelette di un motore Diesel servono, a motore caldo, per regolarizzare le accensioni del gasolio quando il motore ruota a regime di potenza massima

records.localized_text: When a diesel engine is warm, glow plugs regularize fuel ignition at maximum power speed.

source.text_it: In un comune motore Diesel il gasolio viene iniettato nei cilindri alla pressione di circa 25 Bar

records.localized_text: In a conventional diesel engine, diesel is injected into the cylinders at about 25 bar.

source.text_it: La pompa di iniezione del motore Diesel viene fatta funzionare da una cinghia trapezoidale

records.localized_text: A diesel injection pump is driven by a V-belt.

source.text_it: Quando la temperatura esterna è molto fredda è bene alimentare il motore Diesel con una miscela di gasolio (70%) e benzina o alcool (30%)

records.localized_text: In very cold weather, a diesel engine should be fueled with a mixture of 70% diesel and 30% petrol or alcohol.

source.text_it: La cartuccia dei filtri del gasolio deve essere sostituita ad ogni revisione periodica del veicolo

records.localized_text: Diesel filter cartridges must be replaced at every periodic vehicle inspection.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel a iniezione indiretta, il gasolio è iniettato direttamente nel cilindro

records.localized_text: In an indirect-injection diesel engine, diesel is injected directly into the cylinder.

source.text_it: Il motore Diesel ha maggiori problemi di rendimento in altitudine rispetto al motore a scoppio

records.localized_text: A diesel engine has greater efficiency problems at altitude than a spark-ignition engine.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, se la pompa di alimentazione ha funzionamento elettrico, può trovarsi immersa all’interno del serbatoio del combustibile

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, an electric feed pump may be submerged in the fuel tank.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, la pompa di alimentazione a bassa pressione spinge il combustibile dal serbatoio alla pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the low-pressure feed pump moves fuel from the tank to the injection pump.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, la pompa di alimentazione di un motore Diesel è azionata dal motore o dalla pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the feed pump is driven by the engine or the injection pump.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, la pompa di iniezione spinge il gasolio in pressione agli iniettori nella quantità richiesta dal pedale dell’acceleratore

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the injection pump sends pressurized diesel to injectors in the quantity requested by the accelerator pedal.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, se la pompa di alimentazione cessa di funzionare, il motore si arresta

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, if the feed pump stops working, the engine stops.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, ogni 10 rifornimenti di combustibile è necessario ripulire il filtro della pompa di alimentazione

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the feed pump filter must be cleaned every 10 refuelings.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, quando il clima è molto freddo, la pompa di alimentazione del combustibile deve essere accesa dal conducente con apposito pulsante, alcuni secondi prima della messa in moto del motore

records.localized_text: In very cold weather, a diesel fuel feed pump must be switched on by the driver with a dedicated button a few seconds before starting the engine.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, la pompa di alimentazione a bassa pressione deve essere posizionata sul veicolo in un punto lontano da fonti di calore, oppure deve essere opportunamente coibentata

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the low-pressure feed pump must be positioned away from heat sources or suitably insulated.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, la pompa di alimentazione a bassa pressione è dotata di anticongelatore da attivare durante la stagione fredda

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, the low-pressure feed pump has an antifreeze device to activate in cold weather.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, la pompa di alimentazione del combustibile a funzionamento elettrico non può mai trovarsi nel serbatoio a causa del pericolo d’incendio che ciò comporterebbe

records.localized_text: An electric diesel fuel feed pump can never be in the tank because of the fire hazard.

source.text_it: Tutti i motori Diesel sono dotati di regolatore del numero di giri

records.localized_text: All diesel engines have a speed governor.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, l’iniezione del gasolio a controllo elettronico permette di regolare la quantità di gasolio iniettato ed anche la tempistica dell’iniezione

records.localized_text: Electronic diesel injection control regulates both the quantity injected and injection timing.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, sui veicoli dotati di iniettori pompa non è montata la pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: Diesel vehicles with unit injectors do not have an injection pump.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori pompa dei motori Diesel di ultima generazione sono a controllo elettronico

records.localized_text: Latest-generation diesel unit injectors are electronically controlled.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori sregolati causano una cattiva combustione del gasolio

records.localized_text: Misadjusted diesel injectors cause poor fuel combustion.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori sregolati causano un maggior consumo di combustibile

records.localized_text: Misadjusted diesel injectors increase fuel consumption.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori sregolati causano un maggior inquinamento atmosferico

records.localized_text: Misadjusted diesel injectors increase air pollution.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE for an ordinary diesel: use the fuel specified by the manufacturer. However, purpose-modified compression-ignition engines exist for ED95, an ethanol-based fuel with additives; it is not neat bioethanol.
evidence: Official superiori question 29306 prints FALSO. Scania https://www.scania.com/group/en/home/newsroom/news/2018/scanias-bioethanol-engine-reduces-CO2-emissions.html describes modified compression-ignition ED95 engine; ED95 contains ignition improver and lubricants, not neat ethanol. Ordinary engines require manufacturer-approved fuel.

rows.text: Glow plugs mainly help cold starts by heating the chamber; some also remain active after starting. They do not regulate ignition at maximum power with a warm engine.
evidence: https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/services/downloads/parts_14/sp_glp_kombi_brochure_en.pdf — pre-riscaldamento e post-riscaldamento delle candelette.

rows.text: Injection pressure is much higher than 25 bar, to atomize fuel in the chamber. The exact pressure depends on the system.
evidence: https://www.lsm-diesel.dk/2012/bukh/pdf_dv/bm_dv36me_uk.pdf — sistema diretto con pressione di apertura iniettore 210 bar; https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/injectors/unit-injector-ohw/ — sistema unit injector a 1.800 bar.

rows.text: The injection pump is driven in time with the engine, for example by gears or a toothed belt, rather than the ordinary accessory V-belt.
evidence: https://www.lemigas.esdm.go.id/uploads/dokumen/PENINGKATAN_DAN_PEMANFAATAN_BIOFUEL_B40_B50.pdf — figura 8 distingue cinghia dentata della pompa e cinghia trapezoidale accessori; https://www.5021.tips/ujanja/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/perkins-engines-workshop-manual.pdf — sezione K5, ingranaggio della pompa.

rows.text: Do not add gasoline or alcohol to diesel: the mixture can cause hazards and engine problems. In cold weather use diesel suited to the temperature and the manufacturer’s specifications.
evidence: https://www.fordservicecontent.com/ford_content/catalog/owner_guides/0373l733e.pdf — vieta benzina e alcol nel gasolio; https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1845478&Uid=G1845477&buildtype=web%2F1000&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&moidRef=G539544&userMarket=USA&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=4097 — gasolio adattato stagionalmente.

rows.text: Filter replacement is maintenance governed by the manufacturer’s schedule and operating conditions; it does not necessarily coincide with every periodic vehicle inspection.
evidence: https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1751322&Uid=G1728442&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&userMarket=usa&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=7241 — intervallo di manutenzione e sostituzione anticipata in caso di bassa pressione.

rows.text: With indirect injection, diesel enters a prechamber connected to the main chamber, where combustion continues; it is not sprayed directly into the main chamber.
evidence: https://discovery.engine.kubota.com/dictionary/057/ — descrizione della precamera e del percorso della combustione.

rows.text: At altitude thinner air reduces the power of both engines. In traditional naturally aspirated engines a diesel can be less affected because of its excess air, so it is not always more affected.
evidence: https://rosap.ntl.bts.gov/view/dot/10310/dot_10310_DS1.pdf — confronto con motore a benzina a carburatore, eccesso d’aria e perdita di potenza; https://engineering.mit.edu/ask-an-engineer/which-engine-is-better-at-high-altitude-diesel-or-gasoline — minore densità limita entrambi.

rows.text: An electric supply pump can be installed in the tank to send fuel toward the injection system.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/pumps/fuel-supply-module/ — modulo con pompa elettrica installato nel serbatoio; https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — descrizione sistema diesel.

rows.text: The supply pump transfers diesel from the tank to the high-pressure circuit; the injection pump raises it to the required pressure.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/pumps/high-pressure-pump-cp4/ — alimentazione dal serbatoio al raccordo di bassa pressione e mandata al rail; https://kdtrading.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ford-2700-Workshop-Manual.pdf — pompa di alimentazione verso filtro e pompa iniezione.

rows.text: In mechanical supply pumps, the drive can come from the engine or the injection pump drive. Electric pumps also exist and use a different drive.
evidence: https://kdtrading.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ford-2700-Workshop-Manual.pdf — pompa azionata da eccentrico dell’albero a camme; https://media.defense.gov/2014/Jun/20/2002655915/-1/-1/1/140620-N-ZZ182-6557.pdf — ingranaggio di comando pompa di trasferimento; https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/pumps/fuel-supply-module/ — pompa elettrica.

rows.text: In traditional injection-pump systems, the pump pressurizes and meters fuel for the injectors according to the acceleration demand. In common-rail systems the control unit commands the dose through the injectors.
evidence: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-W-e50cadd0968d975fe52520a62abbcd44/pdf/GOVPUB-W-e50cadd0968d975fe52520a62abbcd44.pdf — pompe e regolazione della mandata; https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/pumps/high-pressure-pump-cp4/ — pompa alimenta il rail.

rows.text: If the supply pump stops and fuel no longer reaches the injection system, the engine stops after the fuel available in the circuit is used up.
evidence: https://kdtrading.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ford-2700-Workshop-Manual.pdf — trasferimento alla pompa d’iniezione; https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1845478&Uid=G1845477&buildtype=web%2F1000&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&moidRef=G539544&userMarket=usa&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=4097 — restrizione del filtro può causare arresto.

rows.text: There is no universal requirement to clean the filter every ten refills: maintenance follows the manufacturer’s instructions and operating conditions.
evidence: https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1751322&Uid=G1728442&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&userMarket=usa&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=7241 — manutenzione programmata e sostituzione se la pressione è bassa.

rows.text: Switching on the pump with a button before a cold start is not a general procedure. Fuel supply depends on the vehicle’s system; glow plugs help with cold starting.
evidence: https://kdtrading.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ford-2700-Workshop-Manual.pdf — pompa meccanica azionata dal motore; https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/services/downloads/parts_14/sp_glp_kombi_brochure_en.pdf — candelette per avviamento a freddo.

rows.text: The pump does not always have to be placed away from heat or insulated: in some engines the mechanical pump is mounted directly on the engine block.
evidence: https://www.dieselmann.no/files/H%C3%A5ndb%C3%B8ker/Verksted%20h%C3%A5ndb%C3%B8ker/903%20Workshop%20Manual%20TPD1345E3.pdf — operazione 11-9: pompa fissata al blocco con giunto; https://kdtrading.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ford-2700-Workshop-Manual.pdf — pompa sul blocco.

rows.text: The supply pump does not require an antifreeze device to be activated every winter. Cold-weather fuel problems are addressed with fuel formulated for the temperature.
evidence: https://kdtrading.no/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Ford-2700-Workshop-Manual.pdf — funzionamento della pompa meccanica; https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1845478&Uid=G1845477&buildtype=web%2F1000&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&moidRef=G539544&userMarket=USA&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=4097 — carburante stagionale.

rows.text: An electric pump designed for this purpose can be in the tank; fire risk does not always rule out this location.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/pumps/fuel-supply-module/ — modulo con pompa elettrica nel serbatoio.

rows.text: The governor controls engine speed by adjusting the fuel quantity to keep operation within the intended limits. It may be mechanical or electronic.
evidence: https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/236000/cdc_236000_DS1.pdf — regolatore su ogni Diesel e controllo mediante portata combustibile; https://www.perkins.com/en_GB/products/engine-performance/machine-speed-control.html — regolatore meccanico o elettronico.

rows.text: Electronic control can determine both the amount of fuel injected and when injection starts, adjusting them to engine conditions.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/injectors/unit-injector-ohw/ — elettrovalvola determina inizio e quantità d’iniezione.

rows.text: In a unit-injector system each unit combines the high-pressure generating element with the injector, so no separate high-pressure injection pump is needed. The low-pressure supply circuit remains.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/injectors/unit-injector-ohw/ — pompa per cilindro integrata nell’iniettore e alimentazione a bassa pressione.

rows.text: In electronically controlled unit injectors, an electronically controlled valve regulates injection timing and quantity while the integrated pump generates pressure.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/injectors/unit-injector-ohw/ — principio di funzionamento e comando elettronico dell’elettrovalvola.

rows.text: An incorrect spray mixes fuel and air less effectively and worsens combustion. Injectors must therefore deliver and atomize fuel as designed.
evidence: https://evirtual.insteclrg.edu.ec/pluginfile.php/70252/mod_resource/content/1/%28Bosch%20Professional%20Automotive%20Information%29%20Konrad%20Reif%20%28eds.%29%20-%20Diesel%20Engine%20Management_%20Systems%20and%20Components-Springer%20Vieweg%20%282014%29_compressed.pdf — p. 195: deviazioni del getto peggiorano utilizzo dell’aria; https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — iniettore difettoso e combustione incompleta.

rows.text: An altered spray makes combustion less effective and can increase fuel consumption because some fuel is used less efficiently.
evidence: https://evirtual.insteclrg.edu.ec/pluginfile.php/70252/mod_resource/content/1/%28Bosch%20Professional%20Automotive%20Information%29%20Konrad%20Reif%20%28eds.%29%20-%20Diesel%20Engine%20Management_%20Systems%20and%20Components-Springer%20Vieweg%20%282014%29_compressed.pdf — p. 195: deviazione del getto aumenta consumo e fuliggine.

rows.text: An injector with a poor spray can cause incomplete combustion and more pollutants, such as soot and unburned hydrocarbons.
evidence: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — iniettore difettoso, combustione incompleta ed emissioni; https://evirtual.insteclrg.edu.ec/pluginfile.php/70252/mod_resource/content/1/%28Bosch%20Professional%20Automotive%20Information%29%20Konrad%20Reif%20%28eds.%29%20-%20Diesel%20Engine%20Management_%20Systems%20and%20Components-Springer%20Vieweg%20%282014%29_compressed.pdf — p. 195: deviazioni del getto e emissioni.

issues.reason: Il quesito afferma senza qualificazioni che un motore Diesel può essere alimentato anche con bioetanolo ma la risposta stampata è FALSO. Un costruttore documenta un motore a bioetanolo che funziona secondo il principio diesel ad accensione per compressione: non è chiaro se il quesito intenda solo motori diesel convenzionali non adattati.
checked_sources: PDF ufficiale conseguimento-superiori-it, pagina 102 (indice 101), quesito 29306: risposta stampata FALSO.

https://www.scania.com/group/en/home/newsroom/news/2018/scanias-bioethanol-engine-reduces-CO2-emissions.html — motore a bioetanolo ED95 con additivi, funzionante secondo il principio diesel ad accensione per compressione.
https://www.fordservicecontent.com/ford_content/catalog/owner_guides/0373l733e.pdf — su questo motore diesel convenzionale non aggiungere alcol al gasolio.
